title: Magenta CdTe solar panels support broccoli cultivation in agrivoltaic trial
content:
Researchers in Sweden and Italy have investigated the performance of semitransparent, magenta-colored cadmium telluride (CdTe) thin-film solar panels designed to transmit wavelengths favorable for broccoli growth. The study found that the panels affected microclimatic conditions, photosynthetic performance, nutrient composition, and overall land productivity.

title: Study reveals up to 15% gap between expected and actual bifacial gains in utility-scale PV
content:
Researchers in Spain have found that the effective bifaciality of solar modules in utility-scale PV plants can be up to 15% lower than their nominal rating. Based on two years of operational data from a 50 MWp solar plant in Spain, with findings validated across four additional installations in Spain and the United Kingdom, the study highlights the influence of irradiance, temperature, mounting geometry and operating conditions on rear-side power generation.

title: Trina Solar researchers propose new classification of ultraviolet-induced degradation in TOPCon solar cells
content:
